# What check-state.py still finds on main, and what removes each line. See CLAUDE.md, State, and ADR 0114.
#
# Every pull request that fixes a finding deletes its lines. Lines may only leave: a new one, or a higher limit, fails
# CI. Only a line tagged "# may become a marker" may leave by becoming a marker in the script's MARKED, with its reason;
# a new tag fails too. The last pull request of the work deletes this file and sets ENGINE_LIFECYCLE_LIMIT in the
# script.
#
engine-lifecycle-fields 41

# Two machines the other rules cannot see, as they look at how fields are declared and written, not what values mean.
# Each gets a change of its own.
# docker_in_stop is read in five places, and pairs with Control's shutdown mode (Force plus Failed reads as Detach).
C6 docker_in_stop
# warm.learned: UNIX_EPOCH stands for stale.
C6 warm.learned

# Slot occupant: split. busy, job and job_started become one value owned by Occupant, in its own leaf file.
C1 core Occupant
C3 busy job &&
C3 busy job ||

# Watch: split. A capture and its recapture become one value per runner.
C2 captures recaptures

# Job followed: split. queued_jobs, closing and claims become one map of a job's phase.
C1 core Claims
C2 closing queued_jobs

# Repository presence: split. draining folds into repositories, so these false pairs go with it.
C1 core Drain
C2 draining repositories
C2 draining retired
C2 draining slots

# Repository state: split. Its listing, holds and waits each become one sealed value, the waits last.
C1 core RepositoryState

# Pool health: split into one enum.
C1 core PoolHold

# Pool waits: split. Waits seals, and cpu_held moves in.
C1 core Waits

# Replayer: seal, with the pool waits. It is one replay's working state and never outlives the call: it moves to
# admission/replay.rs, a leaf, with its fields private.
C1 core Replayer

# Measured: split raised (slot occupant), the wait sets (wait accounting) and the host band out; the host band's change
# then seals what stays, the predictor and the log memos, with private fields.
C1 core crates/core/src/scheduler/engine/admission.rs:Measured

# Host band: split into one enum.
C1 core Remembered

# Profile upkeep: split. These become one map of a profile's upkeep.
C2 measure_due measured_at
C2 measure_due measures
C2 measure_due oversized
C2 measure_due reseed_due
C2 measure_due reseed_requested
C2 measured_at measures
C2 measures reseed_due
C2 oversized reseed_due
C2 oversized reseed_requested
C2 reseed_due reseed_requested
C2 reseed_memory reseeded_at
C2 reseed_memory reseeds
C2 reseeded_at reseeds

# Record list: split list and listed into one value; the same change seals recordings and shells behind methods.
C1 core crates/core/src/scheduler/engine/records.rs:RecordState

# TUI prompt: split confirm, removal, resize and help into one value; a marker then covers App's other fields, each a
# view's own data.
C1 cli App # may become a marker
